title: Installed-wheel Python runtime pull-request validation
summary: The Python SDK is tested as a user would install it: the built wheels are installed into a fresh virtual environment outside the repository, and the test first proves that the installed files, not the source checkout, are what runs.
firstReason: The Python SDK is in scope (DH-ADR-1), and testing the installed artifact with an identity check before any behaviour test is independent of what the runtime inside the wheel is written in.

title: Remove the Python SDK's unused reverse RPC direction
summary: Proposal: the Python SDK client only sends requests and receives responses and notifications; its unused ability to receive requests from the server and answer them is removed.
firstReason: Adopt: the SDK server never sends a request to the client, so the Go design's Python client can be one-directional from the start. The SDK wire protocol is free to change under DH-ADR-2, which makes this the cheapest moment to drop the unused direction.
